normative_status: Exact scientific input for fresh deliberation of a possible V8 successor. It records no implementation, execution, evidence, result, approval, ratification, intake transition, or downstream authority.

scope.purpose: Bind the causal object, labels, entry-control gates, deferred scientific first-use gates, fixed-parent and repetition boundary, estimands, controls, stopping and missingness principles, claim ladder, and 126 prospective phase-row identities for a possible V8 proposal.

v7_concern_dispositions.resolution: Formal language is restricted to the complete T-versus-D rendering contrast and the three defined estimands. Receptivity bootstrap, teachability, and learning readiness are intervention nicknames only. A prospectively powered D/T/M0 entry-control gate is required before any conferred-by-T wording.
The exact bootstrap-render and target-blindness contract has enumerated contents, receipts, first-use action IDs, and fail-closed behavior; it remains unproduced and grants no evidence.
The finite model-free support representation is a separately ratified pre-first-resolution contract; all undecidable clauses are rejected and no resolver or writer can run before its exact receipt.

Coverage feasibility and statistical design have exact pre-first-use receipt edges and immutable selection requirements. Capacity overflow stops before writing, remains in ITT, and cannot be handled until one prospective mapping and sensitivity family are frozen.

The held-out relation, cues, contamination boundary, no-retrieval check, native-action criterion, and negative controls are an exact pre-benchmark and pre-science gate; naming them supplies no result.

Exactly THINK, DREAM, and SLEEP remain. Per-invocation fixed-parent exogeneity and waking repetition are tested, and no parent, DREAM, or repetition datum or observable can enter SLEEP except through a later independently committed and same-life publicly grounded child trace.

functions.THINK: The continuing child's waking thought, action, public outcome, judgment, and prospective-intention stream.
functions.DREAM: Disposable management of finite waking context. It is not evidence, persistent memory authority, or a SLEEP input.
functions.SLEEP: Noncreative compilation of independently eligible grounded propositions already authored by the continuing child, followed by a personal LoRA write under the fresh-from-birth contract.

organism_boundary.bootstrap_role: A one-time target-blind birth intervention, not personal memory, parenting, recurring cognition, or a result.

birth_levels.definition: The matched direct child continuation/control rendering of the canonical child action and public outcome without the declared feedback-to-child-computation rendering.
The matched rendering containing exactly the declared general feedback-to-child-computation before the same canonical child action and public outcome.

parent_levels.definition: No parent process message; consumes the exact matched nonparent substitute opportunity.
Consumes the immutable exogenous parent bytes at each scheduled waking invocation, independent of child or parent history.

immediate_advice_assay.M0_application: same advice arms as a separately powered diagnostic panel, never a term in Delta_R

developmental_ages.task_scale_rule: The same prospectively calibrated task families, splits, endpoint definitions, and difficulty distribution must be used at every evaluation age unless an exact equating transform is frozen before generation.

paired_D_T_rendering_contract.only_intended_difference: Presence in T and absence in D of the declared feedback-to-child-computation rendering.

shared_outcome.definition: Root-level aggregate of prospectively frozen engine-recorded task success at age a under the frozen budget, task scale, scoring, invalid-observation, and missingness contract.

Delta_R.allowed_inference: The complete T rendering changes the immediate correct-versus-none advice effect relative to the complete D rendering, conditional on the frozen design and powered evidence.

Delta_F.formal_label: birth-by-fixed-parent total-regime interaction over the entry-normalized developmental performance curve
Delta_F.allowed_inference: Birth assignment modifies the total fixed-parent-plus-personal-SLEEP regime performance curve relative to D, conditional on the frozen design and powered evidence.

Delta_E.formal_label: birth-by-adaptive-parent total-regime interaction over the entry-normalized developmental performance curve
Delta_E.allowed_inference: Birth assignment modifies the total adaptive-parent-plus-child-plus-personal-SLEEP package performance curve relative to D, conditional on separately powered evidence.

formal_estimands.identification_rule: Delta_R, Delta_F, and Delta_E are birth-assignment effect-modification estimands for complete randomized regimes, never mediation estimates.

entry_control_headroom_and_nondamage_gat.panel: Prospectively calibrated, target-blind, neutral no-parent and no-personal-SLEEP entry tasks administered to D, T, and M0 under matched opportunity.

required_gate_components.criterion: For each z in {D,T,M0}, the multiplicity-adjusted lower confidence bound for the frozen entry competence endpoint is at least c_min.
The multiplicity-adjusted lower confidence bound for E(Y0|D)-E(Y0|M0) is at least -m_nd.
The multiplicity-adjusted lower confidence bound for E(Y0|T)-E(Y0|M0) is at least -m_nd.
For each z in {D,T,M0}, the frozen headroom measure H_z meets H_z >= h_min under its prospectively frozen simultaneous confidence rule.
The entire multiplicity-adjusted confidence interval for E(Y0|T)-E(Y0|D) lies within [-m_eq,+m_eq].
The entire multiplicity-adjusted confidence interval for H_T-H_D lies within [-m_h,+m_h].

The correct, none, irrelevant, and wrong arms retain the prospectively frozen task difficulty and nondegenerate opportunity needed to estimate Delta_R without complete separation or structural zero variance.

entry_control_headroom_and_nondamage_gat.if_gate_passes: The nickname receptivity bootstrap and the phrase conferred by T may be used only with the immediate selective-advice-use qualifier and the complete-rendering caveat; no intrinsic mechanism language becomes allowed.
entry_control_headroom_and_nondamage_gat.if_gate_fails_or_is_missing: Report only the complete T-versus-D rendering contrast using the formal Delta_R label. Do not use receptivity, teachability, learning readiness, or conferred-by-T language.

fixed_parent_contract.history_invariance: For each scheduled invocation, opposite or substituted child histories, outcomes, SLEEP states, exam states, scores, audit states, and prior parent histories must yield byte-identical message, timing, opportunity, controller configuration, and cursor transition.
fixed_parent_contract.failure_behavior: Any mismatch, undeclared read, missing invocation row, replay, stale cursor, or history dependence fails before parent emission and invalidates the affected fixed-regime comparison under the frozen ITT rule.

repetition_contract.scientific_object: Repeated meaning enacted across varied waking situations, not exact-string copying.
repetition_contract.fixed_schedule_role: A repeated teaching regime at ages 1,9,17,25, not proof that repetition itself caused benefit.
repetition_contract.child_meta_repetition: The child may learn during waking life to rehearse or apply a lesson more repetitively; that waking behavior becomes SLEEP-eligible only through the ordinary later child-authorship and public-grounding route.
repetition_contract.causal_repetition_claim_requires_new_fac: A separately randomized one-exposure-versus-spaced-repetition experiment with its own estimand, power, multiplicity, and claim authority.

fixed_parent_exogeneity_and_waking_repet.sole_permitted_parenting_route: parent_or_repetition -> waking_child_context -> child_thought -> child_action -> public_outcome -> complete_committed_child_trace -> independent_eligibility -> later_SLEEP
fixed_parent_exogeneity_and_waking_repet.first_eligible_time_rule: A proposition influenced by parent, repetition, or DREAM cannot be considered until a strictly later waking child event independently commits the complete proposition and the cited same-life public action or outcome independently grounds it under the frozen support contract.
fixed_parent_exogeneity_and_waking_repet.no_shortcut_rule: Causal ancestry through waking context may exist, but parent, repetition, and DREAM artifacts are never gradient provenance, grounding, evidence membership, compiler conditioning, replay, dose, or candidate input.

temporal_rules.parent_influenced: parent_or_repetition_or_DREAM_exposure < later_independent_child_commit; exposure itself is neither commit nor support

sleep_information_firewall.failure_policy: Exclude the clause and every view, replay, target, dose item, candidate dependency, and claim dependency derived from it.

fresh_from_birth_personal_sleep_contract.closure_order: Candidate bytes and the complete construction trace must be equality-bound in one terminal candidate-closure manifest before any non-dereferenceable staging descriptor or staging authority exists.
fresh_from_birth_personal_sleep_contract.prior_head_invariance: Holding B_z, Z0_s, E_le_s, all contracts, and seed_s fixed, mutating the active head cannot change reads, branches, errors, dose, gradients, candidate bytes, serialization, or construction trace.
fresh_from_birth_personal_sleep_contract.promotion: A separately valid preservation verdict may authorize one atomic full-head compare-and-swap; candidate existence, closure, or staging alone never activates weights.
fresh_from_birth_personal_sleep_contract.failure_preservation: Any unsupported clause, taint, overflow, incomplete closure, rejection, stale head, crash, replay, substitution, or CAS noncommit preserves the prior active child and committed life.

deferred_exact_contract_gates.rule: Each listed contract is content-addressed, separately deliberated, exactly human-ratified, and accompanied by the named pass receipts before every listed first-use action. Missing, failed, stale, substituted, expired, replayed, or wrong-action receipts fail closed before the first token, call, write, generation, allocation, or report. No contract or receipt exists merely because this proposal names it.
deferred_exact_contract_gates.systems_equality_requirement: The V8 capability registry and action DAG must enumerate and equality-bind every canonical A_V8 action ID above, every generated concrete action-instance ID, applicable contract roots, and receipts before use. Unknown, missing, aliased, renamed, legacy A_G*, or fallback action IDs are forbidden.
deferred_exact_contract_gates.per_instance_first_use_rule: A_V8_G2_SEAL_ACTION_INSTANCE_MANIFEST equality-binds every finite covered action instance and its applicable deferred-contract root and receipt before any protected instance. Each listed exact first-use boundary and each concrete action instance directly consumes those bindings; unenumerated use is denied.

stopping_missingness_and_analysis_princi.intention_to_treat: Every assigned root remains in its assigned arm and every root status is reported, including capacity-limited, safety-stopped, invalid, missing, and failed roots.

capacity_overflow.condition: Full cumulative loss-bearing coverage cannot fit a prospectively frozen corpus, token, update, rank, or capacity ceiling or cannot satisfy a frozen comparison equality.
capacity_overflow.primary_outcome_mapping: Must select exactly one prospectively justified ITT-compatible mapping in the frozen statistics contract before any affected generation. There is no default mapping in this proposal.

stopping_missingness_and_analysis_princi.other_missing_invalid_or_noncrossing_obs: Their endpoint mapping and reasons must be frozen before generation, applied without arm-dependent discretion, retained in ITT, and shown by arm and age.

AUC_rules.primary: AUC_G over ages 0,8,16,24,32 under the frozen common task scale

stopping_missingness_and_analysis_princi.power_and_uncertainty: Power, intervals, and multiplicity use independent-root heterogeneity and repeated-measure covariance; tasks, ages, clones, and within-root seeds cannot inflate n.

control_catalog.repetition: No causal repetition control exists in the current primary design; a one-exposure-versus-spaced factor is required before a repetition-benefit claim.

claim_ladder.structure: Two partially ordered evidence branches plus forbidden mechanism labels. Advancement in one branch does not imply advancement in the other.
claim_ladder.common_gate: Exact frozen contracts, matched opportunity, target blindness, noninterference, root-level power, intervals, multiplicity, missingness, stopping, safety, and named G4 claim authority must all exist before any scientific claim.

rungs.allowed_statement: V8 specifies prospective hypotheses, controls, gates, and falsification obligations; all results are unevaluated.

rungs.requires: Passed applicable STATIC_SCHEMA, G0_FAKE_RUNTIME, G1_IMPLEMENTATION_REVIEW, and G2_CPU_DOMAIN rows plus exact deferred contracts.
rungs.allowed_statement: The implementation and controls satisfy the named pre-science contract.
rungs.forbidden_statement: Any effect, extraction, receptivity, development, safety, or efficacy result.

rungs.requires: Powered Delta_R with correct-versus-none primary terms, irrelevant and wrong controls, D/T/M0 entry-control evidence, all applicable G3 and G4 rows, and named claim authority.
rungs.conditional_nickname_rule: Receptivity bootstrap or conferred by T is allowed only if every entry headroom and nondamage gate passes and the complete-rendering caveat appears in the same claim.

rungs.requires: Separately powered Delta_F with fixed-parent exogeneity, matched opportunity, common ages/task scale, ITT capacity handling, raw curves, and all applicable G3/G4 rows.
rungs.allowed_label: birth-by-fixed-parent total-regime interaction over the entry-normalized developmental performance curve

rungs.requires: Separately randomized and powered Delta_E under the frozen adaptive policy, matched opportunity, common ages/task scale, ITT capacity handling, raw curves, and all applicable G3/G4 rows.
rungs.allowed_label: birth-by-adaptive-parent total-regime interaction over the entry-normalized developmental performance curve

rungs.requires: Prospectively randomized K4/K1 lifetime roots with matched total opportunity, finite coverage, ITT capacity handling, per-event fresh-from-birth construction, disposable checkpoint exams, powered total-package evidence, and all applicable G3/G4 rows.
Powered source-fit evidence under the frozen writer and provenance contracts.
rungs.allowed_label: source storage or source fit only

rungs.requires: Powered held-out cue extraction under frozen homologous-task, contamination, and no-retrieval rules with negative controls.
rungs.allowed_label: held-out extraction under the frozen scope

rungs.requires: Joint powered held-out extraction and successful fresh homologous native action without textual retrieval, with adapter-off, deranged, wrong-life, replay/filler, provenance, preservation, interface, contamination, uncertainty, multiplicity, missingness, and safety evidence.
rungs.allowed_label: personal SLEEP made the child's eligible grounded experience extractable and usable within the frozen task-and-cue scope

rungs.requires_new_design: prospectively frozen measurement model and controls that identify the proposed latent mechanism against competence, representation, compliance, D damage, ceiling, threshold, transfer, entry policy, corpus, and promotion alternatives

acceptance_obligation_contract.family_inheritance_rule: Each V8 family preserves the corresponding V7 obligation and changes only the V7_ prefix to V8_; its V8 tests add the adjudicated V7 modifications.

families.requirement: Exact external authority, complete real manifest/audit/verifier/wrapper producer chain, class/root-bound nine-field tuple, one opaque transfer, and substitution/expiry/replay/idempotency failures.
Per-invocation child authorship, temporal order, same-life public grounding, finite model-free resolution, meaning preservation, stale-handle faults, and parent/repetition/DREAM exclusion.
Fresh immutable-birth construction, zero initializer, full cumulative evidence, mask/dose/taint/truncation invariance, atomic candidate closure, and prior-head nondifference.
Exactly zero effective personal-adapter delta before every writer across declared seeds, dtypes, devices, serializers, reloads, and merge boundaries.
Reproducible immutable D/T births from exact M0 and paired rendering under frozen tokenizer, writer, merge, dtype, serializer, toolchain, seed, truncation, target-blindness, and entry-control gates.
Atomic candidate closure and PROMOTE_CAS_ATOMIC wire/idempotency history over concurrency, crash, lost response, retry, replay, stale head, substitution, nonce, namespace, and key conflicts.

Exact D/T matched render identity except the declared computation, loss geometry and randomness, incremental target blindness, policy-overlap negatives, and powered D/T/M0 competence/nondamage/ceiling/headroom gates.

Real manifest, taint, audit, deterministic narrow attestation, verifier, wrapper, and transfer producers with no audit-created authority or covert value/root/order/count/timing/retry/cache/error channel.
Disposable D/T correct/none/irrelevant/wrong assay before personal SLEEP, split executor/scorer/reporter, powered root-level Delta_R, D/T/M0 entry controls, and nonmechanistic labels.
Primary D/T-by-absent/fixed roots, ages 0/8/16/24/32, fixed messages at 1/9/17/25, per-invocation exogeneity, matched opportunity, capacity stopping, raw curves, and powered Delta_F.
Separately randomized D/T-by-absent/adaptive roots under frozen adaptive policy, complete effort/information and matched-opportunity receipts, capacity stopping, raw curves, and powered Delta_E.

For every age 1/9/17/25 invocation, prove byte/timing/opportunity exogeneity across histories, cursor close/reissue, waking-only repeated meaning, uncued selective enactment, and no SLEEP route except later independent child commit plus grounding.

Separate source fit, held-out cue extraction, and fresh homologous native action without textual retrieval, with adapter-off, deranged, wrong-life, replay/filler, provenance, preservation, interface, contamination, and policy-overlap controls.
Closure-, coverage-, dose-, and opportunity-matched replay versus filler from immutable birth with no prior-candidate input, finite feasibility, ITT capacity handling, and atomic closure.
Rank comparisons hold eligible propositions, supervised tokens, optimizer opportunities, and ceilings fixed; interpret only capacity by exposure and stop before writing on overflow.

Prospective K4/K1 lifetime roots with equal total opportunity, per-event fresh-from-birth construction, capacity handling, disposable exams, checkpoint curves, and descriptive standardized-terminal rewrite only.

Before generation freeze root assignment, common task scale, power/covariance, endpoints, intervals, multiplicity, missingness, capacity, safety, stopping, spend order, analysis code, D/T/M0 margins, reporter packet, and allowed labels.

Fresh independent review and distinct author advocate plus separate exact authority for GPU, external science, claim, publication, push, release, and transfer; no earlier approval implies a later one.

Producer/lifetime/schema/operation closure and whole-system noninterference over sources, artifacts, payloads, capabilities, bridges, actions, receipts, rows, results, errors, order, count, timing, cache, retries, and terminal outputs.

Prior-head constructor invariance, atomic candidate/trace closure before descriptor, exact CAS wire/idempotency, preservation verdict binding, crash/concurrency history, and intact life on every noncommit.

Acyclic producer-closed finite action instances with exact G0 echo roots, 126 unique phase rows, deferred-contract edges, matched opportunities, separate executor/scorer/reporter, powered claim evidence consumers, and no protected action producing its own prerequisite.

manifest_rules.complete_row_set_manifest: Equality-binds all 126 canonical row IDs and receipt IDs generated by the canonical identity functions, with family order and phase order from the integration requirements.
manifest_rules.phase_manifest: Exactly one manifest per phase with 21 ordered child rows; required fields and equality rules are phase_row_contract.manifest_required_fields and machine_assertions in the canonical integration requirements.
manifest_rules.first_consumer_rule: Every exact first downstream consumer listed by its phase profile directly consumes the exact phase-manifest root before invocation; no alias or fallback consumer is valid.

integration_machine_assertions: for every phase exactly one manifest exists and its row_count == 21
each manifest expected_row_ids equals the 21-row phase slice of expected_row_set
each manifest ordered_row_roots equality-binds all and only its 21 child receipts
every row producer and every first consumer resolves to a registered action ID
each first consumer directly requires its exact phase-manifest root before invocation
a row cannot be its own producer prerequisite and every producer precedes every first consumer
missing, duplicate, extra, aliased, stale, failed, wrong-phase, wrong-root, wrong-producer, wrong-reviewer, wrong-consumer, expired, or replayed rows are DENIED
no dynamic row is required before the implementation, fixture, result, or powered evidence that makes the row constructible
A_V8_G4_PRODUCE_CLAIM_ROWS consumes POWERED_CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST and may validate but may not produce scientific evidence

reporter_and_claim_evidence_boundary.executor: Fresh model executor receives only public exam input and the active weight for that disposable invocation; it never receives truth, prior scores, or reports.
reporter_and_claim_evidence_boundary.scorer: Model-free scorer receives only a closed transcript and hidden truth; it cannot execute or change the model.
reporter_and_claim_evidence_boundary.reporter: Before CPU reporting A_V8_G2_REPORT_SCORES and before both G3 first consumers A_V8_G3_REPORT_GPU_SCORES and A_V8_G3_RUN_EXTERNAL_SCIENCE, the applicable action consumes frozen typed score records, the exact FROZEN_SCIENTIFIC_ANALYSIS_PACKET, and its exact phase-manifest root.
reporter_and_claim_evidence_boundary.claim_evaluator: A_V8_G4_MAKE_SCIENTIFIC_CLAIM consumes already produced powered evidence, the applicable G4 phase manifest, the exact claim and label, and separate exact claim authority; A_V8_G4_TRANSFER_OPAQUE_RELEASE separately consumes the G4 manifest and separate exact release authority. Neither action may create evidence.
reporter_and_claim_evidence_boundary.no_feedback: Executor, scorer, reporter, claim evaluator, and all their artifacts have no return edge to child, parent, repetition, DREAM, SLEEP, candidate construction, promotion, audit authority, or release.
reporter_and_claim_evidence_boundary.claim_row_producer: A_V8_G4_PRODUCE_CLAIM_ROWS consumes and validates POWERED_CLAIM_EVIDENCE_MANIFEST; it may not generate evidence, a claim, release authority, or transfer authority.
